description: TypeScript library and CLI that renders AWS Step Functions state machines (ASL definitions, CloudFormation/SAM/CDK templates, Terraform configs or live AWS state machines) as SVG, Mermaid, HTML or PNG diagrams, with diff and execution overlays.
rules: AGENTS.md lists every entry point, its runtime and the common mistakes; check it before importing from a subpath.
Functions take a single flat object parameter: options sit beside aslDefinition, e.g. generateSvg({ aslDefinition, layout: 'LR', theme: 'dark' }), never under an options key.

Runtimes: 'sfn-diagram', 'sfn-diagram/cfn' and 'sfn-diagram/terraform' run in Node, browsers and edge. 'sfn-diagram/png' (exportPng), 'sfn-diagram/aws', 'sfn-diagram/ci' and the CLI are Node-only. 'sfn-diagram/element' is browser-only.
generateFromAwsResponse is exported from the root 'sfn-diagram' entry, not from 'sfn-diagram/aws'.
The extractors return an object: const { aslDefinition } = extractAslFromTemplate({ template }) from 'sfn-diagram/cfn', or extractAslFromTerraform({ config }) from 'sfn-diagram/terraform'.
When a template or Terraform config defines more than one state machine, also pass resourceId: the CloudFormation logical ID, or the Terraform resource name (e.g. aws_sfn_state_machine.orders).
